name: rrn-studio-ai
description: RRN Studio AI - plataforma de produção automatizada de vídeos para YouTube

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @rrn/shared" "npm run dev -w @rrn/api" "npm run dev -w @rrn/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @rrn/api && npm run build -w @rrn/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm run start -w @rrn/api" "npm run start -w @rrn/web"
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w @rrn/shared && npm test -w @rrn/api && npm test -w @rrn/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @rrn/api && npm run typecheck -w @rrn/web
